## ACCEPT — PR objectui#9147. ⭐ The round corrected this seat's premise in the one way that changed the DESIGN

Reviewed against the diff, ⛔ not the report. Head `7ae23d6d3`, **9/9 required contexts success**, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success. One file, **+338, −0**.

### ⛔ My claim said 「two files read a manifest's `test` script, and **both are per-instance pins**」. Half of that is wrong, and the half that is wrong is the load-bearing half.

`scripts/__tests__/runner-package-test-entry-3746.test.ts` is ⛔ **not** a per-instance pin. It walks `WORKSPACE_GROUPS` with `readdirSync` and carries a real population leg. Its assertion:

```js
expect(bareEntries.filter((dir) => !BARE_ENTRY_BASELINE.includes(dir))).toEqual([]);
```

⇒ that is a **SUBSET** assertion. It reds when a **new** bare entry appears and is ⛔ **silent when a listed one leaves**.

⭐ **That is exactly the property this card needed to get right, and my wrong premise pointed away from it.** Had the dev taken 「both are per-instance pins」 it would have had no reason to think about assertion direction at all. Instead it read the file, found the existing pin is **both the precedent for the shape AND the counter-example for the direction**, and built the new carrier on **equality**:

```
describe('objectui#9106 — the zero-test exclusion, asserted by EQUALITY so it can expire', …)
  … .toEqual(recorded)
```

⇒ ⭐ the exclusion expires **in both directions**, which is the one property the dispatch asked for and the one a subset assertion silently drops. ⛔ Credit that, ⛔ do not file it as a detail.

⚠️ My conclusion — 「no carrier exists」 — survives, and the dev re-ran the `8991` grep to confirm it returns exactly the two incidental files. It also named a **third** reader I missed, `package-scripts-vitest-projects.test.ts`, which pins the ROOT manifest's `--project` names. ⇒ my list of two was incomplete by one; ⛔ not a population derivation either, so the conclusion holds.

### Verified independently by this seat

| check | result |
|---|---|
| files changed | **1** — `scripts/__tests__/zero-test-member-exclusion-9106.test.ts`, +338 |
| the existing pin's assertion | **subset** (`filter(...).toEqual([])`), confirmed at `:251` |
| the existing pin enumerates | **yes** — `WORKSPACE_GROUPS` + `readdirSync` at `:94-97` |
| the new carrier's structure | 4 `describe`s: the derivation can fail · the exclusion **by EQUALITY** · the two buckets either side (**both** `toEqual([])`) · **the premises the exclusion rests on** |
| anything outside `scripts/__tests__/` | **0** |

⭐ The fourth `describe` is what makes this a carrier rather than a comment: **the recorded reason is pinned beside the recorded list**, so the reason cannot go stale silently while the list stays green. ⚠️ That is the defect objectui#5406 found in prose one level over, closed by construction.

### ⭐ The re-derivations, and one correction to the CARD

- **The three exit-1 readings reproduce**, with the `packages/layout` control of known direction exiting **0** on 21 files / 217 tests. ⇒ three 1s **with** a 0 beside them is a measurement; three 1s alone would not have been.
- ⭐ **The card's `apps/site` mechanism is right in conclusion and wrong in reason.** The card says an app 「comes back through the root config's `projects` array as its own project rooted at the app directory」 — that is objectui#8240's mechanism for **`console`**, transplanted. `apps/site` is in **no project at all**. ⇒ derived, ⛔ not cited: the dev **planted a real test file** at `apps/site/` and the identical shape at `examples/hello-world/` as control — the control collected and passed, `apps/site` still reported 「No test files found」, and `--project @object-ui/site` errored 「No projects matched」. ⇒ the option-D fence is confirmed **by measurement**, and it is stronger than the card argued.
- **「47 workspace manifests」 is 46** under `packages/*`, `apps/*`, `examples/*`; 47 is reachable only by counting the root manifest.

### ⭐ The fence held, and the finding was filed rather than ridden in

⛔ No `test` script for the three. ⛔ No `--passWithNoTests`. ⛔ No `--project` entry for `apps/site`. ⛔ objectui#8991's three landed entries untouched.

⚠️ And the round found something adjacent and **left it alone**: `packages/plugin-ai` and `packages/vscode-extension` carry `--passWithNoTests` while **both DO have test files**, so those two entries cannot notice their own collection going empty. ⇒ filed bare as **objectui#9146**, and the new pin stays green with those flags in place — ⭐ correctly, because that is a **different bucket** from the zero-and-zero one this card rules on. ⛔ Folding it in would have widened the card past triage's ruling.

⇒ **ACCEPT.** Flipping to ready and arming the queue; the Armed note with the probe goes up **before** the merge.

## Armed — `SQUASH`, merge queue entered. ⭐ Probe written HERE, ⛔ before the merge

`added_to_merge_queue` confirmed. Head `7ae23d6d3`; **9/9 required contexts success**; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success **post-flip**. One file, **+338, −0**.

Every expected value below was read off `7ae23d6d3`.

```bash
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && git fetch origin main -q
F=scripts/__tests__/zero-test-member-exclusion-9106.test.ts
ts(){ git show "origin/main:$1/package.json" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('scripts',{}).get('test','ABSENT'))"; }

echo "── FLOOR — the carrier must exist, or nothing below means anything ──"
git cat-file -e "origin/main:$F" && echo "carrier PRESENT" || echo "carrier VOID"

echo "── POSITIVE, per file ──"
printf '%-52s %s\n' 'lines (floor 330, landed 338)'        "$(git show origin/main:$F | wc -l)"
printf '%-52s %s\n' 'top-level describe( (expect 4)'       "$(git show origin/main:$F | grep -cE '^describe\(')"
printf '%-52s %s\n' 'toEqual(recorded) — the EQUALITY (expect 1)' "$(git show origin/main:$F | grep -c 'toEqual(recorded)')"
printf '%-52s %s\n' 'ZERO_TEST_MEMBERS mentions (floor 4)' "$(git show origin/main:$F | grep -o ZERO_TEST_MEMBERS | wc -l)"

echo "── SURVIVED — objectui#8991's three entries, HASH paired with the STRING ──"
for p in packages/layout packages/test-support examples/console-starter; do
  printf '%-30s %s  %s\n' "$p" "$(git rev-parse "origin/main:$p/package.json" | cut -c1-12)" "$(ts $p)"
done

echo "── NEGATIVE — what must NOT exist, each with a firing control ──"
for p in apps/site examples/byo-backend-console examples/hello-world; do
  printf '%-32s test script: %s\n' "$p" "$(ts $p)"
done
printf '%-52s %s\n' 'passWithNoTests in those three (expect 0)' \
  "$(git grep -c passWithNoTests origin/main -- apps/site/package.json examples/byo-backend-console/package.json examples/hello-world/package.json | wc -l)"
printf '%-52s %s\n' 'CONTROL passWithNoTests in plugin-ai (expect 1)' \
  "$(git grep -c passWithNoTests origin/main -- packages/plugin-ai/package.json | wc -l)"
git cat-file -e origin/main:apps/site/vitest.config.ts     2>/dev/null && echo "apps/site config  EXISTS (BAD)" || echo "apps/site config  absent   (good)"
git cat-file -e origin/main:apps/console/vitest.config.ts  2>/dev/null && echo "CONTROL console config EXISTS (good)" || echo "CONTROL console config absent (BROKEN PROBE)"
```

### Expected, and where each number comes from

| leg | expect | read from |
|---|--:|---|
| carrier present | **PRESENT** | the only file the PR adds |
| lines | **338**, floor 330 | ⭐ a **floor**, not equality — a later PR may legitimately add a case |
| top-level `describe(` | **4** | derivation-can-fail · the EQUALITY · both buckets · **the premises** |
| `toEqual(recorded)` | **1** | ⭐ **the assertion this whole card turns on** |
| `ZERO_TEST_MEMBERS` | **4**, floor 4 | the named list, referenced by each leg |
| `packages/layout` | `8997c4a75393` · `vitest run --root ../.. packages/layout/` | ⭐ hash **and** string |
| `packages/test-support` | `707f95732617` · `vitest run --root ../.. packages/test-support/` | ⭐ hash **and** string |
| `examples/console-starter` | `74aa71934ea1` · `vitest run --root ../.. examples/console-starter/` | ⭐ hash **and** string |
| the three `test` scripts | **ABSENT** ×3 | the ruled direction |
| `passWithNoTests` in the three | **0** files | the ruled direction |
| CONTROL in `plugin-ai` | **1** file | ⭐ so the 0 above is a **real zero** |
| `apps/site/vitest.config.ts` | **absent** | option D not taken |
| CONTROL `apps/console/vitest.config.ts` | **EXISTS** | ⭐ so the absence above is a real absence |

⭐ **Why the survival legs carry a hash AND the string.** A hash alone goes stale the moment any unrelated field in that manifest moves — a version bump would read as a regression. The string alone cannot tell a surviving entry from a rewritten one. ⇒ **hash matches** = byte-identical survival; **hash differs but the string still reads exactly as above** = the manifest moved for another reason and objectui#8991's work survived; **string differs or gone** = objectui#8991 was reverted, which is a real regression and ⛔ not this PR's doing.

⚠️ ⭐ **The two controls are the point of the negative side.** 「no `passWithNoTests` in these three」 and 「no `apps/site` vitest config」 are both **absence** claims, and an absence claim from a query that cannot fire is worth nothing. The `plugin-ai` and `apps/console` controls hit **in the same run, on the same instrument**. ⇒ a zero beside a one is a reading; a zero alone is not.

⚠️ And the `plugin-ai` control is doing double duty: that hit is the subject of **objectui#9146**, filed bare by this round — two members carry `--passWithNoTests` while **having** test files. ⛔ Deliberately out of this card's bucket, and the new pin stays green with those flags in place.
